name: Data.auxLift_principalRep
summary: Test both sides against formAction(s)Ξ for all Ξ (formAction(s) is bijective); adjointness and the equivariance of θ reduce this to the invariance of the inner products.

steps.claim: Two algebraic forms on V_j are equal when their inner products with every Ξ agree, and since formAction(auxPair(D, ϑ, j))(s) is bijective it suffices to test against formAction(s)(Ξ). By adjointness (`Data.inner_auxLift`), ⟨auxLift(principalRep(s) y), formAction(s)Ξ⟩ is a Petersson product on W_j with θ(formAction(s)Ξ); θ(auxPair(D, ϑ, j))(formAction(s)Ξ)(g) = θ(auxPair(D, ϑ, j))(Ξ)(g·(1, k)) for a lift k of s (`AuxPair.theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction`, `reduceFamily_liftResidue`); the inner products are invariant under the two actions (`Space.inner_formRep`, `AuxPair.innerAt_formAction`), and adjointness again (`Data.exists_theta_to_principalForms`) gives ⟨formAction(s)(auxLift y), formAction(s)Ξ⟩.
steps.lean:
(D.auxPair ϑ j).formAction s (D.auxLift ϑ j y) := ext_inner_right ℂ
  (((formAction _).apply_bijective s).2.forall.2 fun Ξ ↦ by
  rw [inner_auxLift, ← funext (theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction _ _ (reduceFamily_liftResidue s) Ξ),
    ← (exists_theta_to_principalForms ..).choose_spec j.2]; exact
    (inner_formRep ..).trans ((innerAt_formAction ..).trans
    ((exists_theta_to_principalForms ..).choose.adjoint_inner_left ..)).symm)
